restaurantName: DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh – Queensferry Crossing
bio: A sanctuary from city living, The Shore is the perfect setting for drinks, Afternoon Tea, conversation & simply watching the world go by. The team at The Shore will make you feel right at home.  The Afternoon Tea is served in the main dining area of the Shore Restaurant, enjoy amazing views of the Queensferry Crossing whilst experiencing our delicious, handmade Afternoon Tea.  The Afternoon Tea menu is dynamic, every day the chefs change the delicious sweet treats, enhancing the experience for customers.
